name: Database Dashboard
description: Admin report at /admin/reports/database showing the site database size and the top-20 tables by size and by row count, with a dedicated cache-tables view.
project_description: Database Dashboard adds a read-only administration report at /admin/reports/database (Reports › Database Dashboard) that surfaces the overall database size in GB and the twenty largest tables by size and by row count, plus a separate breakdown of the cache_* tables. It queries MySQL/MariaDB information_schema through a second database connection (keyed 'schema') that the site admin must declare in settings.php pointing at the information_schema database. It ships a controller, a theme hook and a small CSS library, and is intended for basic capacity monitoring of a Drupal database. Depends on the core mysql module.
